runtime: node 22, express, PostgreSQL, node-media-server, mediasoup; no build step
deployment: Production release layout /opt/openvibe.live (current -> releases/<time>-<sha>), unit openvibe-live.service on the systemd socket 127.0.0.1:3000, deployed with `sudo ovhost deploy live --wait-idle`.
features: RTMP, WHIP, WebRTC and JSMPEG ingest; viewer playback; the broadcast page
channels, go-live, stream keys, managed streams, restreaming (managed ingest on OpenRestream)
the watch page and its chat surface (messages stored by OpenVibe.Chat), TTS, sounds, emotes, overlays
VODs and clips recorded and stored by OpenVibe.Media; pastes and comments on OpenVibe.Community
AI viewers, stream memories, overviews, moments, recaps, translation: every prompt an OpenVibe.AI template; VOD and clip transcripts by window on OpenVibe.AI
streamers' own AI keys stored encrypted in OpenVibe.AI; per-streamer daily AI budgets as AI quotas
channel points and Vibes; the Arena (Battle Cam); after-show recaps; the Star of OpenVibe
per-actor limits on API writes; account export and deletion contributions; follows on OpenVibe.Network
channel ↔ OpenVibe.Bot robot binding, its dashboard field and the Bot panel iframe on the channel page behind LIVE_BOT_EMBED (off by default)
